routes.title: Clementi · A neighbourhood in one meal
routes.subtitle: Market, Teochew temple and a multi-ethnic table
routes.note: At the two hawker centres, pick one small portion at each; no need for two full meals. Visit the mosque only under its visitor rules. The route uses real road crossings. The order is an editor's suggestion, not live map routing.

routes.title: Sunset Way · Old flavours and the riverbank
routes.subtitle: Old-style bakery, Ulu Pandan waterway, neighbourhood ice cream
routes.note: Check first that the waterway section is open. The old railway bridge is saved separately; don't cross the river on the bridge deck. If the connector is temporarily closed, keep just the bakery and ice cream stops.

routes.title: NUS · Half a day at two museums
routes.subtitle: Asian art and Southeast Asian natural history
routes.note: Take a bus from Clementi to the University Cultural Centre area, then walk between the museums. Days when both are open are usually Tuesday to Saturday; check public holidays and any gallery updates.

routes.title: Telok Ayer · The faiths of one street
routes.subtitle: Migrant landing history in a single walk
routes.note: Cultural institutions on the same street have different visitor rules; only places with finished cards are shown below. Check booking and religious etiquette for each.

routes.title: Katong · Into everyday Peranakan life
routes.subtitle: Shophouses, home collections and distinctive tables
routes.note: Private home collections and historic houses must be booked in advance. The shophouses in the photos are still lived in; stay on public roads.
